tuning: No historical-task retrieval results inspected before this registration; only synthetic behavior tests. This is a frozen untuned starting point, not an optimized ranking.
baseline: Case-insensitive fixed-string OR search of the same normalized terms over identical eligible files; deterministic path/line order; same excerpt/packing/counter limits. No interactive query refinement.
label_scope: Twenty registered development candidates, pre-fix source relevance labels; does not establish behavioral eligibility for agent trials. Holdout candidates are not queried. Nonce negative controls are separate synthetic checks.
premeasurement_corrections: Synthetic anchor priority, qualified symbol matching, JSON accounting preserving key order, and lockfile exclusion verified before any historical retrieval result.
